release.description: Use Google Drive as the single entrypoint for Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides work.

interface.long_description: Use Google Drive as one unified Google file plugin for search, file organization, sharing, and Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Slides workflows.
interface.default_prompt: Search my Drive for the latest Q4 board deck and write a 10-bullet executive recap with the 3 biggest risks and 3 next actions
default_prompts: Search my Drive for the latest Q4 board deck and write a 10-bullet executive recap with the 3 biggest risks and 3 next actions
Rewrite this product one-pager using our brand guidelines doc: match the voice and format while keeping facts intact
From [folder], pull key deliverables, timeline, and open questions, then draft a client-ready status update

skills.name: Local
skills.description: Create and edit native Google Docs through connected tools.

interface.short_description: Read, edit, and create Google Docs files.
interface.default_prompt: Use $google-docs to create or edit a native Google Doc while preserving its styles and structure.

skills.name: Local
skills.description: Use this skill to find and manage files in Google Drive, including organizing files, managing sharing, exporting files, and checking revision history. When a request also involves editing a file's contents, use the corresponding Docs, Sheets, or Slides skill in this plugin.

interface.short_description: One entrypoint for Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides
interface.default_prompt: Use $google-drive to find the right Drive file, then summarize a Doc, update a Sheet, or edit a Slides deck through the unified Google Drive workflow, including refreshing linked charts or replacing static chart content from an existing connected source such as Google Sheets.

skills.name: Local
skills.description: Write, reply to, and resolve Google Drive comments on Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive files with evidence-backed location context. Use when the user asks to leave comments, review a file with comments, respond to comment threads, or resolve Drive comments.

interface.short_description: Write, reply to, and resolve Drive comments
interface.default_prompt: Use $google-drive-comments to leave, reply to, or resolve comments on Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, or Drive files with precise evidence.

skills.name: Local
skills.description: Analyze and edit connected Google Sheets with range precision. Use when the user wants to create Google Sheets, find a spreadsheet, inspect tabs or ranges, search rows, plan formulas, create or repair charts, clean or restructure tables, write concise summaries, or make explicit cell-range updates.

interface.short_description: Find sheets, inspect ranges, and plan batch updates
interface.default_prompt: Use $google-sheets to find the right spreadsheet, inspect a range, search rows, or plan an exact batch_update.

skills.name: Local
skills.description: Route Google Slides authoring requests and derive a design system from a native template or reference deck. Use this skill when the user provides an existing native Google Slides deck as a template, reference, or prior-period source, or asks to edit, update, repair, restyle, or clean up an existing native Google Slides deck. Use the Presentations skill instead for net-new presentation creation when no existing native Google Slides deck must be followed.

interface.short_description: Create, adapt, inspect, and edit Slides decks
interface.default_prompt: Use $google-slides to create, adapt, inspect, summarize, or edit a Google Slides deck, including following a native Slides template/reference deck or importing a PPTX.
